# Fenek Sport

> Multi-brand e-shop specializing in combat sports equipment and martial arts supplies for boxing, MMA, Muay Thai, kickboxing, BJJ, and taekwondo.

Fenek Sport is a Czech-based online retailer offering comprehensive equipment for various combat disciplines. The store carries premium brands like Hayabusa, Paffen Sport, Damage Control, and others, serving both beginners and advanced athletes with training and competition gear.

## Key Topics

- Boxing
- MMA
- Muay Thai
- Kickboxing
- Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ)
- Taekwondo
- Boxing Gloves
- Protective Gear
- Combat Sports Equipment
- Training Equipment
- Hayabusa
- Paffen Sport
- Hand Wraps
- Martial Arts Supplies
- Online Store

## Combat Sports Categories

- [Bojové umění - tréninkové a ochranné vybavení](https://fenek-sport.cz/bojove-umeni): Main martial arts category covering boxing, kickbox, Muay Thai, taekwondo, MMA, and BJJ equipment
- [Box - Klasický box vybavení](https://fenek-sport.cz/bojove-umeni/box): Boxing equipment: gloves, helmets, hand wraps, and protectors
- [Muay Thai - Thajský box vybavení](https://fenek-sport.cz/bojove-umeni/muay-thai): Muay Thai equipment: gloves, helmets, hand wraps, and shin protectors
- [Kickbox - Kickboxing vybavení](https://fenek-sport.cz/bojove-umeni/kickbox-1): Kickboxing equipment: gloves, helmets, protectors, and clothing
- [MMA - Mixed Martial Arts vybavení](https://fenek-sport.cz/bojove-umeni/mma): MMA equipment: gloves, helmets, protectors, and shorts from premium brands
- [BJJ - Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu vybavení](https://fenek-sport.cz/bojove-umeni/bjj-1): Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu equipment: kimonos, belts, and accessories by top brands
- [Taekwondo - WTF a ITF standardy](https://fenek-sport.cz/bojove-umeni/taekwondo): Taekwondo equipment per WTF and ITF standards from world brands

## Boxing Gloves & Hand Protection

- [Rukavice - Box, Kickbox, Muay Thai, MMA](https://fenek-sport.cz/rukavice): Boxing and MMA gloves from Paffen Sport, Adidas and other brands
- [Boxerské rukavice](https://fenek-sport.cz/rukavice/boxerske-rukavice): Boxing gloves for beginners and advanced boxers from premium brands
- [MMA rukavice](https://fenek-sport.cz/rukavice/mma-rukavice): MMA gloves for training and competition from world-class brands
- [Pytlové rukavice](https://fenek-sport.cz/rukavice/pytlove-rukavice): Heavy bag gloves and training gloves from TITLE and Cleto Reyes
- [Exkluzivní rukavice](https://fenek-sport.cz/rukavice/exkluzivni-rukavice): Exclusive premium boxing gloves from Bully Boxing and Elion brands
- [Fitness rukavice](https://fenek-sport.cz/rukavice/fitness-rukavice): Gym fitness gloves from RDX, Sting and other training brands
